name: 2-aminoethylphosphonic acid
description: 2-Aminoethylphosphonic acid (CAS 2041-14-7 ), also known as ciliatine, is a naturally occurring phosphonic acid derivative used industrially as a chelating and sequestering agent. It binds divalent and trivalent metal ions, allowing formulators to control trace metal activity in complex systems. In water treatment, it functions as a scale inhibitor and metal sequestrant. This compound prevents calcium and magnesium deposits in industrial cooling and process water circuits. Agricultural formulations use it as a stabilizing additive to protect active ingredients. It prevents metal-catalyzed degradation during storage and field application. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical researchers source it as a reference compound or synthetic building block. It is essential for phosphonate-containing active molecules. As a chelating agent in industrial cleaning and process chemistry, it helps prevent oxidative degradation triggered by free metal ions. 2-Aminoethylphosphonic acid is supplied as a white crystalline powder. Technical and research grades are the most commonly available, with purity specifications typically ranging from 97% to 99%+. Packaging is available in small laboratory quantities through to bulk industrial orders. We provide full documentation support for regulated industries to ensure compliance with global standards.
